_comment: The manual half of the question audit. Every contextual item in the shipped bank and every gap-fill in cloze.json was read; this records the ones where a second option was defensible, what was done, and how it is held closed. The automated half is scripts/level-test-ambiguity-qa.mjs and scripts/question-ledger.mjs — see docs/AMBIGUITY_LEDGER.md.

reviewed.reviewMethod: every contextual stem composed with all four of its options and read; meaning/produce items read as a spread and covered by collideInAnyLocale
reviewed.note: Read twice: once on the bank as shipped at d7a85767, and again on the regenerated bank after the rules and the rewritten examples changed every distractor draw. The second reading found seven more, recorded as A-16 to A-22. Read a third time after the bank was re-levelled by sentence demand (700c78db → this cycle), which changed 68 item levels and therefore every distractor draw. The third reading found one more, A-23.

notFound.levelTestMeaningItems: 1,761 meaning items and 1,761 produce items carry one gloss per taught sense; a distractor sharing the answer's meaning in any of the 32 locales is rejected by collideInAnyLocale at build time. Read as a spread rather than exhaustively — see the limit recorded in docs/AMBIGUITY_LEDGER.md.
notFound.compoundModifierFrames: A blank that is a bare noun in front of another noun — ____ 이야기를, ____ 소식을, ____ 연습을 — is the weakest frame class that survives. Whether two nouns both form a compound with the head is a fact about Korean that nothing in the pack records, so four of them are held by reviewed pairs rather than by a rule. A regenerated bank can produce a new one; the ledger is the place it would be recorded.
